title: Remove turn gating from Engram: no ordinary turn needs a grant, while host observations, claims and acceptance evaluation keep working
outcome: Remove turn gating from Engram: no ordinary turn needs a grant, while host observations, claims and acceptance evaluation keep working
acceptance: No ordinary operation in Engram requires a turn grant, turn_evaluate/turn_begin admission, or gated settlement/recovery; the host channel's turn admission operations are retired in step with TermAl (the live consumer), never removed while an installed TermAl still calls them

Worktree and evaluation association (named root) works through the ordinary session binding with no control-session phase, routing grant or turn requirement, proven with tests on a store that holds exited sessions and old grants
Host-observed execution, source and test-run evidence keeps being recorded without admission, and claims, notes, gates, acceptance evaluation and done keep working unchanged

Historical grants, turn decisions, checkpoints and unknown prior-operation records stay readable as stored; nothing is erased or replayed. Any schema change follows the pre-release migration rule (named retirement with counts via export/import) and its cutover is planned before landing
docs (behavioral control plane, turn gate assessment and evidence, shipped.md, host checklist) describe the shipped state with no gated-turn claims

completion.summary: Closed on Greg's word (Asistant #239): „chyba mozemy zamknac taki gated control, skoro nie mamy tego juz”. No ordinary turn in Engram needs a grant: child w-5b17f50b5079 sealed 9a697f91 with the source and live facts and its limits. Named-root binding, host observations, registered verification and self-asserted done worked today on real turns after the 15:30Z restart, with no grant. Historical records stay readable (doctor reader, migration tests). Limits: an open question remains about evaluation refusing correct checks, which is not gating and is tracked on w-ac88a232578a, so this closure says nothing about evaluation working; docs criterion taken from 12325's note 0da6ed8a that EO docs describe the removal, not re-audited by me; TermAl's side stays on TermAl's own w-3fe8f4472e5d. Self-asserted under the baseline policy, no evaluation.
